summary: The reversed code matches the decompilation, but the supplied P-code conflicts on the value written to param_3.
issues: At 0x006db414, the P-code stores the temporary overwritten by the dereference at 0x006db402, while the decompilation and reversed code store piVar1, the pointer loaded from *param_1. The evidence does not establish which value the binary writes.
fix_instructions: Inspect the machine instructions and register values at 0x006db400–0x006db414. Set *param_3 to the value actually stored at 0x006db414, then recheck the function.
